# Interseptor

> Interseptor is a single-binary HTTP/HTTPS intercepting proxy and security-testing toolkit. AI agents drive the same engine as the web UI through an MCP server (stdio and Streamable HTTP) and a REST/SSE API. These pages explain how to install it, connect, follow the rules, and file findings in one consistent format.

Fetch [llms-full.txt](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/llms-full.txt) first: it is a single file containing the agent guide, the finding-writing contract, and the API and MCP references. Authorized testing only; read the hard rules before sending any request.

## Agent guide

- [Complete guide as one text file](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/llms-full.txt): agent guide, finding contract, API and MCP reference
- [Interseptor for AI agents](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/ai-agents/): Rules, install, MCP and REST setup, workflow, and the finding-writing contract for AI agents

## Core guides

- [Getting started](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/getting-started/): Install, start, and configure Interseptor
- [Workspace guide](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/workspace/): Tour of the workspace menus and response views
- [Findings and reporting](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/findings-and-reporting/): Finding envelope, evidence rules, readiness gates, and report export
- [API and MCP](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/api-and-mcp/): MCP server, REST API, collections API, and finding endpoints
- [MCP cookbook](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/mcp-cookbook/): Task recipes for external agents using MCP tools
- [Collections](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/collections/): Request collections, environments, scripts, trust, and the runner
- [Proxy, TLS, and networking](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/proxy-and-tls/): Proxy listeners, CA trust, TLS interception, and upstream chaining
- [History search](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/history-search/): History filters, Anywhere search, and saved Starlark searches
- [Projects and data](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/projects-and-data/): Projects, imports, exports, archives, and retention
- [Engagement close-out](https://veyal.github.io/interseptor/engagement-closeout/): Checklist for final delivery and cleanup
